title: Kepler to Müller, 17/27 October 1629
author: Johannes Kepler
summary: Amid the ruin of the war, Kepler sends two journeymen to Leipzig to buy a press, have type cast and paper made for printing Tycho Brahe's observations, and asks Müller to advance money from his and Bartsch's funds; with a note on the Danish astronomy of Longomontanus.

notes.note: Compositor (*collector*): the workman who sets the type, letter by letter, into pages.
Pressman (*impressor*): the workman who inks the set type and pulls the sheets on the press.
See the [map of the cities mentioned in this correspondence](https://drive.vjbe.net/2026-10-31-kepler.webp).
Thalers, named after the silver coins of Joachimsthal in Bohemia.
Kepler sends a compositor and a pressman to buy type, which must be cast by a typefounder (*fusor*).
Printer (*typographus*): the master of a printing house, who employed compositors and pressmen.
Wallenstein, Duke of Friedland and Sagan, who paid for Kepler's press.
